get.description: What the top bar and the turn buttons show; null without a campaign.

post.description:
Skip the current turn without flying it ("Pass Turn" / "Begin Campaign").

The new turn is published on the event stream (`new_turn`), so every open screen
reloads its state.

409.description: No campaign is loaded, or it is over.

get.description:
What to confirm before taking off: no player pilot, missing pilots, flights
starting before the mission start.

post.description:
"Fix TOTs automatically": moves each package with a flight starting before
the mission start to its earliest feasible TOT.

"Take off": fast forwards to first contact if the settings ask for it, writes
the mission for DCS, then opens the window waiting for its result.

The client runs the confirmations of `GET /game/mission/checks` first.

409.description: No campaign is loaded, it has not begun, or flights are missing pilots.

put.description: Pauses the turn simulation or runs it at a speed (sim speed controls).

409.description: No campaign is loaded, it has not begun, or the simulation is complete.

get.description:
Every settings page of the campaign: sections, controls, values, defaults.

Generated from the metadata of `game/settings/settings.py`, plus the cheats and
the Lua plugins, so a new setting needs no client code.

put.description: Changes one setting, with the side effects of the Qt settings window.

422.description: The value has the wrong type or is out of bounds.

post.description: Puts every setting of a page back to its default value.

get.description:
Precomputed offline basemap of the theatre (GFX-04.2), in these colours.

Colours are hex RGB without the leading '#'. 404 when the theatre has no
precomputed basemap: the client then draws the landmap polygons.

post.description: Saves to the current save file, or asks for one when the campaign has none.

409.description: when no campaign is loaded, another file dialog is open, the campaign changed during the dialog or the save file is incompatible

500.description: when the file cannot be written

409.description: when no campaign is loaded, another file dialog is open, the campaign changed during the dialog or the save file is incompatible

500.description: when the file cannot be written

post.description: Asks for a save file and loads it; the new campaign arrives as events.

409.description: when no campaign is loaded, another file dialog is open, the campaign changed during the dialog or the save file is incompatible

500.description: when the file cannot be written

post.description:
Asks for a folder and answers once the player closed the dialog.

Does not touch the campaign, so it never takes the game lock.

409.description: when another file dialog is open

post.description: Opens the new campaign wizard without waiting for it.
Opens a Help page in the system browser (the web view cannot).
Closes the application; the shell asks whether to save first.

get.description:
DCS folders and the other install preferences, what is wrong with them, and
whether the first start setup must be shown.

put.description:
Validates and saves the preferences, like the Qt preferences window.

Completing the first start also replaces MissionScripting.lua in the DCS
installation. Port and web interface changes need a restart.

409.description: when a folder is invalid, or the DCS installation folder is left empty without confirmation

post.description:
Opens a Qt screen that the web UI does not have yet (WEB-00.3).

Only queues the dialog onto the Qt main thread: never waits for it.

409.description: when the dialog needs a campaign and none is

post.description:
Opens the Qt package editor of the package flying this flight.

Packages have no ID in the API yet (WEB-03 adds them): a flight stands for its
package.
